Only B holds: 68% of respondents graded 1 to 3, and respondents are 9% of customers, so 68% x 9% = 6.1% of all customers.

Only B holds: October-November runs at 52 rings per jeweller and December at 51.2, A gives 55.2, C 59.3 and D 54, while B (2 jewellers for 94 rings) falls to 47, so B does the least.

Only C holds: share falls from 384/2,390 = 16.1% to 378/3,150 = 12.0%, which is 4.1 points over three years or about 1.36 a year, and reasonable gridline readings stay between 1.2 and 1.5.
Only C holds: 70% of 130,000 is 91,000 single visits out of 175,000 visits, which is 52%.
Only D holds: revenue sums to exactly EUR 335m; losses are EUR 48.4m in 2012 against EUR 52.6m in 2013; 2011 costs are EUR 83.5m, not about EUR 94m; and costs peak in 2014, not 2010.
